faqs.question: How much does it cost to hire a dedicated PHP developer?
faqs.answer: The cost varies depending on project complexity, developer seniority, and engagement model. We offer flexible hourly, monthly, and fixed-price models to fit your budget.

faqs.question: Can you upgrade our existing PHP website to the latest PHP 8 version?
faqs.answer: Yes! We audit your current codebase, update outdated dependencies, fix deprecated functions, and test thoroughly to ensure full compatibility with PHP 8.x.

faqs.question: Which PHP frameworks do your developers specialize in?
faqs.answer: Our team has deep expertise in Laravel, Symfony, CodeIgniter, CakePHP, and Yii, as well as native custom PHP development.

faqs.question: How do you ensure the security of our PHP applications?
faqs.answer: We enforce parameterized database queries (PDO), CSRF tokens, strict data validation, password hashing (bcrypt/argon2), and continuous security auditing.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing maintenance for PHP web applications?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide ongoing maintenance covering regular backups, security patch updates, server optimization, and on-demand feature enhancements.
